notes: 'trample under foot' read as רָמַס's one rendering: 'under foot' restates what trampling itself says rather than a direction the Hebrew does not write (rule 44); the competing added reading is recorded in the unit note.
'young lion' heads on 'lion' by rule 31's ASV-usage test, since the verse writes a bare 'lion' for שַׁחַל.
